_note: Service catalogue: the single source for what is sold, what each package includes and what the customer must send before work starts. tools/intake.py reads this table; the Fiverr gig texts and the customer intake checklist are derived from it, never the other way round. An intake item with 'blocker': true is a required input: without it the Lead Agent asks the customer and does not start (CLAUDE.md -> Lead Agent protocol, step 2). 'limits' are hard package limits; work beyond them is a package upgrade, not a favour. 'never' lists what is never requested or promised, in any package. Adding a service: a block here plus a case in tests/test_governance.py; no code change.

never: server access (no login, no agent, no remote session)
passwords, private keys, tokens or certificates
active scanning or any change on the customer's systems
outputs: internal Turkish report in @reports (reviewer verdict ONAY required)
customer deliverable in @deliverables, in the customer's language
PDF of the deliverable (tools/to_pdf.py), produced only after ONAY
common.data_handling: Customer files live in that customer's private repo (tools/new_customer.py), never in the public system repo. Deleted on request after delivery.

phishing-triage.name: Suspicious email (phishing) triage from the exported message
phishing-triage.input_kind: exported email files (.eml, or a plain-text export of the full headers and body)

basic.title: Single Email Check
includes: 1 exported email reviewed statically, read-only
six-item header checklist: Received chain, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sender-field split, URL and attachment inventory
every finding quotes the exact header or body line
URLs listed defanged and never visited; attachments never opened or decoded
independent reviewer check before delivery

standard.title: Verdict + Response Pack
includes: up to 3 exported emails, each with the full six-item checklist
look-alike domain comparison against the domains you tell me are legitimate
IOC list (sender addresses, domains, URLs, attachment names) for your mail gateway block list
short plain-language warning text you can forward to staff
independent reviewer check before delivery

premium.title: Campaign Triage
includes: up to 10 exported emails, each with the full six-item checklist
campaign correlation: shared infrastructure, reused sender patterns and a message timeline
IOC list and staff warning text
executive summary for non-technical readers
independent reviewer check before delivery

intake.ask_en: The suspicious email(s) as .eml files, or a plain-text export of the FULL headers plus the body. A screenshot or a forwarded copy does not work: forwarding strips the original headers, and the whole check is built on them. Please use a neutral file name (not 'credentials.eml' or 'password.eml').
intake.note_tr: Ekran görüntüsü ya da iletilmiş kopya reddedilir: SPF/DKIM/DMARC ve Received zinciri orijinal başlıklarda durur, iletmede kaybolur. Dosya adı uyarısı kasıtlı: 'credentials', 'secrets' gibi adlar policy.json → sensitive_patterns'e takılır ve bulut oturumunda işi durdurur.

intake.ask_en: Your own domain(s), and the domain the message claims to come from (e.g. your supplier's real website). Needed to judge look-alike domains.
intake.note_tr: Benzer-alan-adı kararı müşterinin gerçek alan adı bilinmeden verilemez; bilinmezse bulgu [DOĞRULANMAMIŞ] olur.

intake.ask_en: Did anyone click the link, open the attachment, enter credentials or make a payment? A plain yes/no/don't know is enough.
intake.note_tr: Evet ise kapsam değişir: bu hizmet e-posta ile sınırlıdır, tıklama sonrası host incelemesi incident-response işidir ve ayrı teklif edilir. Yanıt gelmeden iş başlamaz.

intake.ask_en: Your mail platform (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, on-premise Exchange, other).
intake.note_tr: Engelleme ve kural önerisi platforma göre yazılır; yoksa öneri genel kalır ve bu varsayım raporda yazılır.

intake.ask_en: Partners or services that legitimately send you invoices, so their domains are not flagged.
intake.note_tr: Gelmezse meşru gönderenler de IOC listesine girebilir; teslimde bu sınır belirtilir.

intake.ask_en: How many people in your organisation received it, and whether the copies differ (different recipient names, amounts or links).
intake.note_tr: Kampanya korelasyonu için; tek kopya varsa korelasyon bölümü 'tek örnek' notuyla kapatılır.

basic.title: SSH Check
includes: audit of 1 configuration file, read-only
every finding cites the exact config line
ready-to-apply fix per finding
independent reviewer check before delivery

standard.title: Server Hardening
includes: audit of up to 3 configuration files (SSH + web server + firewall)
CVE check of the reported software versions against NVD and vendor advisories
every finding cites the exact config line, with a fix
independent reviewer check before delivery

premium.title: Full Review
includes: audit of up to 5 configuration files
CVE check of the reported software versions
review of up to 2 log files (auth/access) alongside the configs
executive summary for non-technical readers
independent reviewer check before delivery

intake.ask_en: The configuration file(s) to audit, as attachments. Please remove passwords, keys and tokens first.
intake.note_tr: Paket dosya sınırını aşan gönderide fazlası işlenmez; paket yükseltmesi önerilir.

intake.ask_en: OS and software versions, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04, output of `ssh -V` and `nginx -v`.
intake.note_tr: CVE adımı sürüm olmadan yapılamaz; Basic'te bile raporun kapsamını belirler.

intake.ask_en: What does this server do? (web, database, VPN/bastion, mail, ...)
intake.note_tr: Sertleştirme önerisi sunucunun roluyle çelişebilir; rol bilinmeden öneri yazılmaz.

intake.ask_en: Anything that must stay as it is? (e.g. password login needed for a legacy app)
intake.note_tr: Yanıt yoksa kısıt yok varsayılır ve raporda bu varsayım yazılır.

intake.ask_en: Log files for the review (auth.log / access log), last 7-30 days.
intake.note_tr: Premium'da log yoksa müşteriye sorulur; gelmezse rapor yalnızca config kapsamıyla teslim edilir.

log-analysis.name: Server log analysis for brute force and suspicious logins
log-analysis.input_kind: log files (auth.log, web access log, Windows Security export)

basic.title: Quick Scan

counts reproduced by command, with the command shown
every finding cites the exact log line
independent reviewer check before delivery

standard.title: Full Log Review
includes: 1 log file, full review: failed-to-success chains, sudo use, unusual hours
IOC list (IP addresses and user names) for blocking
every finding cites the exact log line
independent reviewer check before delivery

premium.title: Multi-Log + Timeline
includes: up to 3 log files, correlated across sources
event timeline of the incident window
IOC list and executive summary
independent reviewer check before delivery

intake.ask_en: The log file(s) to analyse, as attachments. Please remove any secrets first.
intake.note_tr: Ekran görüntüsü ya da yapıştırılmış parça yeterli değil: satır sayısı ve sayımlar dosya üzerinden yeniden üretilir.

intake.ask_en: Log type and source, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04 /var/log/auth.log, nginx access log, Windows Security .evtx export.
intake.note_tr: Biçim bilinmeden satır ayrıştırması tahmine döner.

intake.ask_en: The time window you care about (e.g. last 7 days) and the server's timezone.
intake.note_tr: Saat dilimi olmadan 'mesai dışı' bulgusu yazılamaz; yazıldıysa [DOĞRULANMAMIŞ] olur.

intake.ask_en: What does this server do? (web, database, VPN/bastion, ...)
intake.note_tr: Beklenen trafiği ayırt etmek için; yoksa varsayım raporda yazılır.

intake.ask_en: Any IP addresses or user accounts you already know are yours, so they are not flagged.
intake.note_tr: Gelmezse kendi adresleri de IOC listesine girebilir; teslimde bu sınır belirtilir.
